Map feature peaks to scan indices in the Spectra backend

Source: R/build_samples.R
extractScanInfo.Rd

For each (feature, sample), takes the most intense peak (largest into) and lists the scans whose retention time lies in [rtmin, rtmax], plus the scan closest to the peak rt. Uses rtime_adjusted when present, else rtime.

Usage

extractScanInfo(feature_peaks, filenames, spectra_df, target_list = FALSE)

Arguments

feature_peaks

Output of getBackendPeaks().

filenames

File paths indexed by the peaks' sample column, matching spectra_df$dataOrigin.

spectra_df

Per-scan metadata with dataOrigin, acquisitionNum and rtime, e.g. as.data.frame(Spectra::spectraData(sps)).

target_list

If TRUE, keep every peak per (feature, sample) instead of only the most intense.

Value

Tibble with sample, filename, mz, feature, scan_indices (list), apex_scan_index, n_scans.
